Ancient Fire, Living Soil & Restorative Craft

Founded in 2012 in Portland's Hearth Quarter, Verdant Hearth was created as an antidote to industrial gastronomy.

Our Founding Philosophy

"We Do Not Tame the Flame; We Listen to It."

When Chef Julian Thorne opened Verdant Hearth in 2012, many warned that running a high-volume kitchen without gas burners or electric heating elements was impractical. Yet, fire brought an irreplaceable alchemy: a sweetness from charred alderwood and a delicate aroma of burning orchard clippings.

Over the past 14 years, our kitchen has evolved into an ecosystem. We harvest from our on-site edible botanical garden minutes before service and maintain closed-loop composting partnerships with growers across the Willamette Valley.

Chronology

Fourteen Years in the Smoke

Key milestones in our evolution from a modest hearth fire to a nationally recognized culinary destination.

2012

The Spark Kindles

Founded with an outdoor alderwood firepit and an intimate 28-seat room by Chef Julian Thorne.

2015

Edible Conservatory Built

Constructed our glass botanical pavilion, allowing guests to dine enclosed by flourishing herb vines.

2018

Zero-Waste & Mill Integration

Achieved 100% closed-loop organic composting and installed our Austrian stone grain mill.

2021

Living Cellar Certification

Expanded cellar to over 300 verified low-intervention and biodynamic wine labels.

2024

National Acclaim & Hearth Legacy

Recognized among the country’s leading wood-fired culinary sanctuaries.

Artisans of Flame & Earth

Meet the Culinary Masters

Led by passion for wood-fired gastronomy and seasonal botanicals, our culinary team transforms raw terroir into unforgettable dining memories.

Live-Fire Hearth Master
Executive Chef & Co-Founder

Julian Thorne

Raised along the Oregon coastline, Julian honed his culinary mastery in Basque country hearths and French countryside kitchens before returning home to establish Verdant Hearth in 2012. He believes wood-ember cooking is an instinctual dance between wind, wood moisture, and radiant heat.

Distinction ★ James Beard Foundation Nominee
Meet Artisan & View Dishes →
Botanical Confections
Head Pastry Chef

Elena Rostova

Elena treats pastry as an extension of botanical medicine and agricultural heritage. Rather than relying on refined sugars and bleached flours, she crafts desserts using whole grains stone-milled in house, wildflower mountain honeys, and foraged forest berries.

Distinction ★ Valrhona Pastry Innovator
Meet Artisan & View Dishes →
Biodynamic Terroir
Master Sommelier & Beverage Director

Matthieu Laurent

Born in Burgundy into a family of vignerons, Matthieu spent two decades exploring natural vineyards throughout France, Italy, and Oregon before anchoring our beverage cellar.

Distinction ★ Court of Master Sommeliers (DipWSET)
Meet Artisan & View Dishes →
Precision Fire Line Directing
Chef de Cuisine

Marcus Rivera

Marcus oversees evening line operations, coordinating timing between the hearth grill, stone bake oven, and vegetable ember pits so every plate arrives at peak thermodynamic beauty.

Distinction ★ Charcuterie Guild Medalist

Ethnobotany
Lead Forager & Botanical Specialist

Clara Sterling

With a Master of Science in Ethnobotany, Clara forages through private forest tracts in the Pacific Northwest, sustainably gathering wild mushrooms, elderflowers, nettles, and edible blossoms.

In-House Stone Milling
Head Artisan Baker & Miller

Thomas Lind

Thomas is dedicated to reviving single-origin Pacific Northwest heirloom grains. He operates our Austrian granite stone mill, grinding fresh whole flour each morning at 5:00 AM.

Regenerative Ecosystem

Our Growers, Foragers & Fishers

We work directly with 42 generational producers across Oregon and Washington who prioritize soil vitality over yield.

Rainshadow Heritage Farms

12 Years Partner
📍 Sisters, Oregon · Specialty: Pasture-Raised Heritage Pork & Heirloom Wheat

Certified regenerative farm focusing on soil carbon capture and heritage animal breeds.

Cascadia Wild Foraging Co.

9 Years Partner
📍 Mount Hood Foothills, Oregon · Specialty: Wild Morels, Chanterelles & Spruce Tips

Small family cooperative harvesting wild fungi with strict sustainable root protection.

Coastal Tides Day-Boat Fishery

11 Years Partner
📍 Astoria, Oregon · Specialty: Columbia River King Salmon & Dungeness Crab

Hook-and-line commercial fishing vessel dedicated to wild seasonal quota management.

Willamette Stone Creamery

8 Years Partner
📍 Carlton, Oregon · Specialty: Cultured Butter, Labneh & Aged Farmhouse Cheeses

Grass-fed Jersey cows producing rich seasonal butter churned within 24 hours of milking.
